scope: 1214jf (protocol 81, pose version 13, Doppelganger world packet v6, shade kill packet v1, prop rest packet v1, door packet v1 with the Unlock kind, #185): 1214je with locked doors in the door catalog and a shared key unlock. A local native unlock (lock byte 1 to 0) sends Unlock, and the other world calls the native lock routine 0x14074e4c0 (component, 0, 0) like the key branch of 0x14074c5c0; an open order waits while the door is still locked there. The gap was mission-locked-door-v1841b.
